policy.purpose: Structured evidence for whether a glasses model can accept a host's display/data path without turning compatibility questions into SEO articles.
policy.unknown_rule: Absence of a record or an unknown field is not incompatibility.
policy.evidence_rule: Model/host compatibility is recorded only from manufacturer documentation, reproducible testing, or explicitly attributed community evidence. USB-C connector presence alone never proves DisplayPort Alt Mode.

records.host_class: USB-C host with DisplayPort Alt Mode video output
records.notes: A USB-C connector by itself is insufficient; the host must expose compatible DisplayPort video.
